title: selinum simplex
intro: Selinum simplex, commonly known as Queen Anne's lace, is a biennial herbaceous plant in the carrot family (Apiaceae). This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Selinum simplex include its antispasmodic, diuretic, and expectorant properties, making it useful in treating conditions such as menstrual cramps, urinary issues, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Selinum simplex include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
